description: The nichedb /traffic blocklist: IP addresses our own servers banned for exploit attempts, scanning, brute force or spam, each published only after a reviewer (a person, or riotcoder applying published rules) read the evidence and approved it. Newest approvals first. Optional `days` keeps addresses seen in the last N days, `category` one of exploit, brute-force, scanner, spam, other. Without an API key the newest 100 are returned; with one, `limit` (up to 1000) and `offset` page the whole list.

category.description: exploit, brute-force, scanner, spam or other (optional)

days.description: Only addresses seen in the last N days (optional)

limit.description: Rows to return, up to 1000 with an API key

offset.description: Rows to skip, with an API key

name: traffic_list
